description: IRVE Statique + Dynamique is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Petite Borne. This dataset meets the specifications of the schema "static EVIR" and "dynamic EVIR" available on schema.data.gouv.fr. These files are available in real time at any time on the defined URL. Coverage: Petite Borne. The portal shows the English title as "IRVE Static + Dynamic" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Petite Borne. The listing shows 2 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2026-05-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
